column1: # Cairn repo split: where every tracked path goes.
#   source       a file, or a directory when it ends with "/". The LONGEST matching
#                source wins, so a directory can be mapped wholesale and one of its
#   repo         server | web | firmware | door | archive
#                  door     stays in the front door (the existing Cairn repository,
#                           renamed at the end); it is not extracted
#                  archive  not carried to any component; survives in the archive and
#   destination  the path in that repository ("." is the root). Ignored for door/archive.
# This file describes the monorepo at the commit named by split-check --ref. It is
# updated, in the same commit, by every phase that moves a file. The coverage check
# (split-check) fails if any tracked path matches no row, so a new file cannot slip
# Paths that existed only in HISTORY (the old Gleam/Zig/Odin/... stack, deploy/migrations/v2,
# the old compose files) have no row on purpose: git filter-repo keeps only mapped paths, so
# they are dropped from the component repos and remain in the archive.
# ── the device firmware, its emulator and research ──────────────────────────
# ── the protocols: specs and vectors, collected in contracts/ in phase 1 ───────
